description: This file defines the LogViewer class, an Android activity for viewing device logs. It reads log data over a socket connection, processes the data, and displays it in a TextView, supporting real-time updates.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: Main activity class responsible for log viewing interface and background log reading.

classes.name: LogReader
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to handle socket-based log data reading.

classes.name: AppendThrowable
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to handle appending Throwable messages to UI.

classes.name: AppendCharacters
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to handle appending log text to UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, starts log reading thread.

methods.name: appendThrowable
methods.description: Appends error messages related to log reading to the TextView.

methods.name: LogReader.run
methods.description: Continuously reads log messages from socket, processes them, and updates UI.

methods.name: next0
methods.description: Utility method to find the first zero byte in a byte array starting from a given index.
